notes.title: The We Were Here series is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Explorers,[/h2][p][/p][p]Some of you know these halls all too well. You’ve wandered the frozen corridors of Castle Rock, walkie-talkie in hand, voice cracking through the static. You’ve solved puzzles, shouted directions, cracked codes, and yes, maybe left your partner behind once or twice. It happens.[/p][p]For years, the [i]We Were Here[/i] series has tested friendships on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Now, it’s time for a new expedition.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="TF6n0lMsYv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Your favourite co-op adventure is going handheld (or docked, if you want to see your friend betray you on the big screen).[/p][p]To play on Switch, you’ll need two things: a Nintendo Switch Online Membership and an external microphone. The trilogy will also be backwards compatible with the Switch 2, so whether you’re playing on shiny new hardware or your trusty old console, you can still team up together. As always, you and your friend will both need a separate copy of the game you want to play.

If you're new here, [i]We Were Here[/i] games are all about two players, trapped apart in a forgotten place, trying to escape through communication alone. You won’t see each other, and can only talk to each other over your walkie-talkies. Every puzzle you solve depends on how well you work together.[/p][p]If you’re a weathered Explorer, this is your chance to bring a new partner to Castle Rock. That friend who only games on Switch? Time to hand them a walkie-talkie and hope they’re better at reading runes than you were.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're playing curled up in a blanket fort or squeezed into a train seat, remember:[/p][p]You’re never truly alone…[/p][p][/p][h3]See you on the other end of the walkie-talkie,
[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Our Great Studio Migration!
notes.content:
[i]2024 was a year in which our mighty developers haven’t been sitting still—quite the opposite. After months of exploring all the crooks and crannies of the vast terrain of Rotterdam, we have secured a beautiful and spacious new base in the booming city center![/i]

[h2]We are growing![/h2]

Over the past year, our numbers have swelled, welcoming a host of talented and inspiring individuals to the fold. This is great news, but it did come with a downside. Our once-spacious studio at Schiehavenkade began to feel... rather snug. Long queues for the microwaves during feeding hours, overheated meeting rooms, and desks encroaching dangerously close to the entrance—a sure sign it was time to seek new territory. The best part: we have [url=https://youtu.be/oC5Hpgu9VVI]documented[/url] the entire move!

[previewyoutube=oC5Hpgu9VVI;full][/previewyoutube]

We hold beautiful memories of the games we created in our old studio and can’t wait to see what magic unfolds in our new home.

notes.title: Happy frenniversary! 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Explorers,[/h1][p]
[/p][h2]Happy Frenniversary! 🎉[/h2][p]It’s been one whole year since we launched We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip, and what an incredible year it’s been! Let’s take a trip down memory lane and revisit the exciting moments from the reveal of this special game. [/p][p][/p][h3]Crafting a Secret[/h3][p]After the release of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/"]We Were Here Forever[/url] in 2022, our team started plotting the next chapter in the We Were Here series. With Forever being our longest and most intricate adventure, packed with puzzles, mysteries, and expansive locations, we knew we wanted to offer something a little different next. This time, we aimed for something short, sweet, and perfect for explorers who want a bite-sized co-op experience.

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296990/We_Were_Here_Expeditions_The_FriendShip/"]We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip[/url] was born: a game designed to be fun, challenging, and most of all, an absolute blast to play with your friends, whether they’re seasoned fans of the We Were Here series or joining us for the first time. [/p][p] [/p][h3]The Big Reveal at WASD x IGN 🎮[/h3][p]Now, we couldn’t just launch The FriendShip like any ordinary game. No, we wanted to do something BIG, something that would surprise and delight our amazing community! So, we decided to go full stealth mode, keeping the entire game a secret until its grand reveal at WASD x IGN. And what’s better than a surprise? A free surprise! 🎁 We dropped the game for free for the first month, allowing millions of you to hop aboard and set sail on this new co-op adventure.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/2b7241314815735337511a526af068ba87da39bd.jpg"][/img]The response was overwhelming! Over 6 million explorers claimed The FriendShip, joining our ever-growing We Were Here family. 💖 [/p][p][/p][h3]Celebrating Friendship 🫶[/h3][p]At Total Mayhem Games, friendship is the heart and soul of everything we create. It’s the thread that ties all our games together, and it’s the bond we share with you, our amazing explorers. We simply couldn’t have reached this point without your endless love and support.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png"][/img]And guess what? There’s more on the horizon! We've got some exciting stuff coming up. So stay tuned, and always remember: “There are good ships, and wood ships, ships that sail the sea. But the best ships are friendships, and may they always be!”

Here’s to many more adventures together!

[/p][h3]All the best,
Total Mayhem Games[/h3]

notes.title: We are here to share some news!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers! 

We hope everyone is doing well and had a great summer break! We've got new exciting things to share with you all.

[h2] We Are Fighting Loneliness [/h2]

We are incredibly excited to announce that we are working together with [b] British Red Cross [/b] for [b] Operation Anti-Loneliness 2022[/b]!
The core of our games is that you have to team up with someone else, work together and communicate with each other, and we have always encouraged forming bonds and social connections through gaming. So what better way to celebrate Operation Anti-Loneliness than by playing [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]?! 1 in 5 people in the UK are affected by loneliness, and one of the things streamers can do to help is to fundraise money by streaming We Were Here Forever for 5, 10 or 20 hours.

For more information about the fundraiser or if you would like to donate directly to the cause, click [url=https://tiltify.com/british-red-cross/operation-anti-loneliness-2022-7e2b14cb-df96-4753-b105-f8944295f6d5] here [/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/bfb1622a50aaea4e7c4b69838dcac2b386d1e026.jpg[/img]

[h2] We Were Here Forever at Dreamhack [/h2]

Conventions are back! From [b]14-16 October[/b], [b]We Were Here Forever[/b] will be available to play at Dreamhack in Rotterdam, The Netherlands! 
Not only is this on our home turf, this is also the city where the Total Mayhem office is located, so it’s going to be extra special for us. For our Dutch Explorers, or international Explorers who are going to visit, be sure to stop by and say hi! We always love chatting and meeting you all. More info on Dreamhack [url=https://www.rtmgamesweek.com/] here [/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/a1abca540f4d2b44700626c24216a5cb0a122a42.jpg[/img]

[h2] We Are Nominated! [/h2]

In the category [b] Puzzle Game [/b], [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] is nominated by the [b] Tiga Game Industry Awards 2022[/b]! TIGA is a network for games developers and digital publishers and the trade association representing the video games industry in the UK. It’s always an honour to be nominated, fingers crossed! See the list of categories [url=https://tiga.org/news/the-finalists-of-the-tiga-games-industry-awards-2022-are-announced] here [/url]

But the nominations don't stop there. We also got nominated in our home country for the [b]Dutch Game Awards[/b] for [b]Best Audio & Best Game Design[/b]! Go see the list with other great Dutch videogames [url=https://www.dutchgameawards.nl/nominees/]here[/url].

We always love seeing you all get creative, may it be your own projects or [i]We Were Here[/i] related! This amazing Jester cosplay by [url=https://twitter.com/FalmarinDeCarme/status/1572329747568279553] @FalmarinDeCarme[/url] really blew us away! Thank you so much for sharing with us.

We’re super happy with how the game turned out visually too! There are a lot more areas for you to explore. Each with their own lively environment and colours.

Furthermore, the story of Castle Rock will run towards a climax and you’ll finally discover if breaking free from its curse is possible, or perhaps you'll be trapped [i]forever…[/i]

notes.title: We are here Together, to share big news about We Were Here Forever!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,

We’re more than excited to share some big news about our upcoming game [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]! Check out our new reveal trailer here!

[previewyoutube=Ztz99oZXjOU;full][/previewyoutube]

Yes, on May 10 [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] will be released on Steam! Bringing you more puzzles to solve, places to discover and mysteries to unravel. Console versions will follow shortly after!

[h1]Discover what has been forgotten[/h1]
The 4th instalment in our [i]We Were Here Series[/i] is our biggest game yet. You’ll be exploring more of Castle Rock- what’s hiding in the dark corridors, the dungeon below as well as forgotten halls and chambers, once filled with life and joy. A graveyard for those who’ve fallen, a chapel and even a puppet workshop are a few of the new areas awaiting your exploration…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/b1ded59667b617e284be58ad02e7795460574f9d.png[/img]

Castle Rock and the town of Rockbury await your arrival. Swallowed by a terrible curse, Rockbury now only remains as a shadow of its former self. The town's previous inhabitants are long forgotten by time, but their plans of a resistance against the King remain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/015c4facd2ed23adb05d7dd9d4a54556f89bb8fc.png[/img]

Will you be able to unveil the mysteries and solve the puzzles that challenge the two of you? Who knows, perhaps this was all meant to be. You might be a missing puzzle piece of a larger story set in motion in a time long forgotten…
The big question at the end remains; [i]does one ever truly escape Castle Rock?[/i]

[h2]We are Here in live action[/h2]
Besides a new trailer and release date, we have more in store for you! In our live action show [i]We Were Here Stories: Chronicles of Castle Rock[/i], the backstory of the cursed castle in the [i]We Were Here Series[/i] will be told through the eyes of resident Kees Klokkenmaker. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/e538d02998787c7c915b2d9540bc41d6465dac13.png[/img]

The Chronicles bring six chapters, each narrated by one of his descendants. You’ll learn about the fall of a great Dutch king, who went mad in his search for eternal life. How this monarch met his downfall, is for you to discover in the series and game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/69ccc8bf303ec82215404dcda73ff5b2ffdbfd20.png[/img]

The first episode “The Fall of a Kingdom” is already live! Be sure to watch it here!

[previewyoutube=p21_SLlw6jc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]We Were Here Podcast[/h2]

Can’t get enough from all the lore we have for you? Need some refreshment so you’re completely up to date upon [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]’s release? Don’t forget to check out our YouTube channel where we discuss the lore of the series and more! Click [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yUj-sOspqz8]here[/url] for the latest one!

Thank you for everything explorers! 
We can’t wait to see you all play our game!

[h3]Yours Forever,[/h3]
Total Mayhem Games

[b]Dear Explorers![/b]

[previewyoutube=34R0UCd493M;full][/previewyoutube]

In We Were Here Forever, we’re going to bring you explorers a next level experience! Expect an even more intriguing and exciting environment for you to explore with new cooperative puzzles and challenges for you and your partner to unravel. Forever will be the largest and most lively game ever seen in the Series, and that’s just the tip of the iceberg.

There is much more to discover in the cold of the Antarctic. One cannot help but wonder what happened to those explorers who got left behind and does one ever truly escape Castle Rock??

[b]Your wait will not be forever[/b]
We’re sure that you guys want to get your hands on the new game in the We Were Here Series just as much as we would like to hand it to you!

Please be patient, our team is still busy torturing each other by testing the puzzles, making the game even look prettier and spookier, and overall, just being excited for this game. We promise it’s not going to take forever - we’re aiming to bring you the game later this year!
